paragraphs.text: Bartolomé del Presidio was a Legion of Dusk vampire knight and director of the Queen's Bay Company .

Bartolomé was a high officer of the Queen's Bay Company and a spy for Queen Miralda . He carried an enchanted candelabra tethered to his belt and an enchanted whip whose end could be turned into a vicious curved blade. He had a daughter.

As director of the Queen's Bay Company, Bartolomé joined the expedition led by Vito Quijano de Pasamonte to discover the temple of Aclazotz . He was killed by Vito while attempting to protect Amalia Benavides Aguirre and Kellan .
